track: Part B — treatment routing substitution cost (routing-fidelity, cost-of-substitution)
note: misroute_rate = routing disagreement rate between measured marker and H&E-predicted marker (distance-independent; like-with-like with breast receptor routing). mean_cost only for axes with a frozen_map therapeutic distance (braf 0.868); MSI/anti-EGFR are excluded from frozen_map, so null. Treatment axes are operationalised only as routing-fidelity/cost-of-substitution (no drug-structure input, hypothesis_only).

msi_high.mean_cost_note: Preregistered clinical directional distance: (n_FN 7*0.9 + n_FP 11*0.45)/161. misroute_rate reproduces v1.

anti_egfr_eligible.mean_cost_note: Preregistered clinical directional distance: (n_FN 57*0.8 + n_FP 10*0.9)/161. misroute_rate reproduces v1.

braf_v600.mean_cost_note: Keeps the frozen_map antiBRAF__baseline=0.868 cell-line therapeutic distance (unchanged from v1). Parallel clinical directional distance: see braf_v600_note in clinical_routing_distance_preregistered.json.

shuffle_null_caveat: shuffle_null_auroc is a single label-permutation estimate (seed=42) with high variance at small n_pos (15-21); see shuffle_null_robustness.json for the 5-seed null. patient_overlap=0 and site-disjoint split verified.
track_v2: v1 misroute_rate/AUROC verbatim, plus mean_cost filled in (preregistered clinical directional distance). misroute_rate/AUROC unchanged.
mean_cost_scale_caveat: MSI/anti-EGFR mean_cost is on the clinical-decision scale (clinical_routing_distance_preregistered.json); braf mean_cost=0.086 stays on the cell-line frozen_map scale (0.868). The three values are not directly comparable or rankable.
